entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
There’s a very good reason why this is HMNZS Aotearoa’s third consecutive attendance at RIMPAC.

Other participating navies know they will get to maximise their at-sea experience due to our ship’s fast, safe and professional Replenishment-At-Sea (RAS) reputation.

So far during RIMPAC 2026, Aotearoa has conducted 23 fuel replenishments – a total transfer of 12,000,000 litres of F76 diesel.

USS Paul Hamilton, a US Navy guided-missile destroyer, wasted no time recently getting the full Aotearoa experience along with 380,000 litres.

US Coast Guard Cutter Kimball got the same treatment shortly afterwards.

Since commissioning into our Navy in 2020, Aotearoa has conducted 150 replenishments at sea – with our ships and those of our partners.
